WITH pay AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS txn_id, card_scheme, is_credit, aci, issuing_country, acquirer_country, eur_amount, has_fraudulent_dispute,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL CAST(day_of_year AS INT64) - 1 DAY)) AS mth
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Rafa_AI' AND year = 2023
),
mo AS (
  SELECT mth, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS frate FROM pay GROUP BY mth
),
mob AS (
  SELECT mth,
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN vol < 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vb,
    CASE WHEN frate < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN frate <= 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN frate <= 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fb,
    vol, frate
  FROM mo
),
mcc AS (SELECT 7372 AS mcc_code UNION ALL SELECT 5411),
cand AS (
  SELECT m.mcc_code, p.txn_id, p.eur_amount, f.ID, f.fixed_amount, f.rate
  FROM pay p
  JOIN mob b ON b.mth = p.mth
  CROSS JOIN mcc m
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON f.card_scheme = p.card_scheme
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type), 0) = 0 OR 'D' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '>5')
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = b.fb)
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = b.vb)
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code), 0) = 0 OR m.mcc_code IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = p.is_credit)
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci), 0) = 0 OR p.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = IF(p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country, 1, 0))
)
SELECT mcc_code,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pay) AS total_txns,
  COUNT(DISTINCT txn_id) AS matched_txns,
  COUNT(*) AS total_matches,
  ROUND(SUM(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000), 6) AS total_fees_all_matches
FROM cand
GROUP BY mcc_code
ORDER BY mcc_code

stats AS (

  FROM tx
),
bands AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN avg_monthly_vol < 100000 THEN '<100k'
         WHEN avg_monthly_vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN avg_monthly_vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m'
         ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_band,
    CASE WHEN fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%'
         WHEN fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN fraud_pct <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%'
         ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_band
  FROM stats
),
mcd AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN capture_delay = 'manual' THEN 'manual'
         WHEN capture_delay = 'immediate' THEN 'immediate'
         WHEN SAFE_CAST(capture_delay AS INT64) < 3 THEN '<3'
         WHEN SAFE_CAST(capture_delay AS INT64) <= 5 THEN '3-5'
         ELSE '>5' END AS cd_band,
    account_type AS acct
  FROM merch
),
scen AS (
  SELECT mcc FROM UNNEST([7372, 5411]) AS mcc
),
tx_full AS (
  SELECT t.*, s.mcc, m.cd_band, m.acct, b.vol_band, b.fraud_band,
         CASE WHEN t.issuing_country = t.acquirer_country THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS intra
  FROM tx t CROSS JOIN scen s CROSS JOIN mcd m CROSS JOIN bands b
),
matched AS (
  SELECT t.tid, t.mcc, t.eur_amount, f.ID, f.fixed_amount, f.rate
  FROM tx_full t
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f

WITH t AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, card_scheme, is_credit, aci, (issuer_country = acquirer_country) AS intra, eur_amount, has_fraudulent_dispute,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS mon
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Rafa_AI' AND year = 2023
),
m AS (
  SELECT mon, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) AS fvol FROM t GROUP BY mon
),
tm AS (
  SELECT t.*, m.vol, 100 * m.fvol / m.vol AS fraud_pct FROM t JOIN m USING (mon)
),
r AS (
  SELECT * FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` WHERE 5411 IN UNNEST(merchant_category_code)
),
cand AS (
  SELECT tm.psp_reference, tm.eur_amount, r.ID, r.fixed_amount, r.rate
  FROM tm JOIN r ON r.card_scheme = tm.card_scheme
  WHERE (r.is_credit IS NULL OR r.is_credit = tm.is_credit)
    AND (r.intracountry IS NULL OR r.intracountry = CAST(tm.intra AS INT64))
    AND (r.aci IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(r.aci) = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(r.aci) a WHERE a = tm.aci))
    AND (r.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(r.account_type) = 0 OR 'D' IN UNNEST(r.account_type))
    AND (r.capture_delay IS NULL OR r.capture_delay = '>5')
    AND (r.monthly_volume IS NULL OR CASE r.monthly_volume
          WHEN '<100k' THEN tm.vol < 100000
          WHEN '100k-1m' THEN tm.vol BETWEEN 100000 AND 1000000
          WHEN '1m-5m' THEN tm.vol BETWEEN 1000000 AND 5000000
          WHEN '>5m' THEN tm.vol > 5000000 END)
    AND (r.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR CASE r.monthly_fraud_level
          WHEN '<7.2%' THEN tm.fraud_pct < 7.2
          WHEN '7.2%-7.7%' THEN tm.fraud_pct BETWEEN 7.2 AND 7.7
          WHEN '7.7%-8.3%' THEN tm.fraud_pct BETWEEN 7.7 AND 8.3
          WHEN '>8.3%' THEN tm.fraud_pct > 8.3 END)
),
first_rule AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(ID, fixed_amount, rate, eur_amount) ORDER BY ID LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS s
  FROM cand GROUP BY psp_reference
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm) AS n_txn,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT psp_reference) FROM cand) AS n_matched,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT psp_reference FROM cand GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)) AS n_multi_match,
  (SELECT SUM(s.fixed_amount + s.rate * s.eur_amount / 10000) FROM first_rule) AS fee_lowest_id_rule,
  (SELECT SUM(s.eur_amount) FROM first_rule) AS matched_volume,
  (SELECT SUM(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) FROM cand) AS fee_sum_all_matches,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT mon FROM t)) AS n_months
